summary: Each rank has a complete contiguous CSR row stripe. During the timed iterations-times loop, launchSpmv dispatches based on localNnz >= localRows*8: either a warp-per-row kernel or a scalar one-thread-per-row kernel. Both traverse each selected row's full CSR delimiters and store one output per row. Compiled launch helper dispatches to both generated stubs; the two final sm_86 kernels were checked through their stores.
